discovery: Discovery of chaperone-mediated protein folding (molecular chaperones such as the GroEL/GroES and Hsp60 systems that help proteins fold correctly in the cell)
rationale: This is my prediction from my own knowledge, with no web search or file reads. Hartl and Horwich are long-standing favourites for the prize. They have won the Lasker, Shaw, Breakthrough and Albany awards, and their work on chaperones changed how biochemists understand protein folding inside cells. The 2025 prize went to metal-organic frameworks, a materials topic. A committee that rotates between fields could plausibly turn back to biochemistry, and this field is mature, well established, and has clear founders.
